title: Clawback of Earned Credits under Roamhaven Rewards
content:
## Rule

When a stay that already earned Roamhaven Rewards credits is later refunded, and the member's tier provides that earned credits are taken back on refund, the credits earned on that stay, bonus included, are reduced in the proportion that the refunded eligible spend bears to the eligible spend the stay earned on. A clawback is taken from the balance even when that leaves less than was earned elsewhere; it never takes the balance below zero, and any shortfall is forgiven.

## The clawback, defined

The credits clawed back are the credits the stay earned, together with any bonus booked on that stay, multiplied by the refunded eligible spend and divided by the eligible spend the stay earned on. The member's statement shows each clawback against the refunded stay and the earning it reduces.

The amount is taken from the member's credit balance as a whole: the balance left may be lower than the credits the member earned on other stays. Where the balance is smaller than the clawback, the balance is taken down to zero and the rest of the clawback is forgiven.

## Worked clawbacks (hypothetical figures)

A stay earned 33.75 credits and a 6.75-credit Superhost-stay bonus, 40.50 credits in all, on eligible spend of 1350.00 USD. Later, 270.00 USD of that eligible spend is refunded, one fifth of it. The clawback is one fifth of 40.50 credits, that is 8.10 credits.

| Balance before the clawback | Clawback | Balance after | Forgiven |
|---|---|---|---|
| 100.00 | 8.10 | 91.90 | none |
| 8.10 | 8.10 | 0.00 | none |
| 5.00 | 8.10 | 0.00 | 3.10 |
| 0.00 | 8.10 | 0.00 | 8.10 |

## Points of judgement

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| Is the bonus earned on the stay part of what is reduced? | Yes, the reduction applies to the credits earned on the stay, bonus included |
| What is the proportion measured on? | The refunded eligible spend against the eligible spend the stay earned on |
| Can the balance go below zero? | No; it stops at zero and the shortfall is forgiven |
